backup.production_rule: One widened CHECK on telegram_pending.kind (thirteen values to fourteen; nothing is narrowed, so every existing row stays valid). No function, no table, no row is changed. Take the backup, fill restore_point/verified_at, apply within one hour.

forward_verification.name: pending_kind_accepts_awaiting_reply
forward_verification.query: select pg_get_constraintdef(oid) like '%awaiting_reply%' from pg_constraint where conrelid = 'public.telegram_pending'::regclass and conname = 'telegram_pending_kind_check'

forward_verification.name: pending_kind_still_accepts_the_thirteen_existing
forward_verification.query: select bool_and(pg_get_constraintdef(oid) like '%' || k || '%') from pg_constraint, unnest(array['duplicate','large_amount','photo_dup','inventory_sync','advisory_notice','advisory_scan','llm_expense','llm_notice','llm_void_notice','llm_void_txn','llm_void_txns','llm_edit_notice','inventory_count']) k where conrelid = 'public.telegram_pending'::regclass and conname = 'telegram_pending_kind_check'

rollback.safe_until: always (narrows the kind CHECK back after deleting any open awaiting_reply question; nothing saved is lost)

feature_flags.name: telegram_expense_writes_awaiting_reply
feature_flags.required_state: The SPEC-16 telegram-expense build is deployed only AFTER this release is applied. Deployed earlier, every prompt's awaiting_reply insert is refused by the old CHECK and the prompt fails closed before anything is written; the reply-to-a-bot-card refusal (D-195 guard) works either way.

compatibility.evidence: Widened CHECK only, in the exact shape of 20260918000000_telegram_inventory_count.sql, which was rehearsed on Alfred 2026-09-18. The thirteen existing values were read from production pg_constraint on 2026-09-19. pgTAP supabase/tests/database/telegram_awaiting_reply.sql 5 assertions; CI runs it on push (no local Docker).

stop_conditions: any forward verification query returns anything other than its expected value
the restore point is older than one hour
